implemented_capabilities.capability: Citation-provenance audit: retracted works reachable by 0, 1 and 2 citation hops from a bibliography
implemented_capabilities.notes: Resolves DOIs, then runs parameterised Cypher via ro_query to classify each work as RETRACTED, CITES_RETRACTED, TWO_HOP, NO_EXPOSURE_FOUND or NOT_IN_CORPUS with coverage (refs_indexed vs refs_total) and explicit caveats; output is deterministically ordered.

Proposals (REMOVE_OR_REPLACE, SUGGEST_ALTERNATIVE, REVIEW) are only applied for ids the user approves; the server re-runs the audit from submitted text and never trusts client-supplied results; emits a markdown audit report.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Co-citation replacement suggestion for retracted works
implemented_capabilities.notes: Ranks non-retracted papers co-cited with the retracted work; explicitly a heuristic and topical fit is not verified.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Tool-calling LLM audit agent with grounding checks
implemented_capabilities.notes: Read-only tools; allow-list of DOIs the model may query (pasted text or earlier tool output); every DOI in the final answer is checked against tool results (verification.ungrounded); structured audit is computed independently of the LLM; deterministic fallback when no key; opening counts overwritten with verified numbers; completeness retry.

implemented_capabilities.capability: As-of-T0 temporal feature extraction and backtest (author contamination, bibliographic coupling, label-propagation communities)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Real as-of-cutoff Cypher (retracted_at <= $t0), COAUTHOR/BIB_COUPLED derived edges, CALL algo.labelPropagation, and a venue-clustered bootstrap evaluation. docs/RESULTS.md honestly reports the pre-registered success criterion was NOT met (no predictive lift), so this is research scaffolding not a predictor.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Retraction Watch ingestion and author pseudonymisation
implemented_capabilities.notes: Column-minimised CSV parsing, resumable download with SHA-256 provenance metadata, HMAC-SHA256 author id hashing (min 32-char salt).
In-memory sliding window per IP plus global daily budget for LLM calls; active only when BEDROCK_PUBLIC=1.

graph_models_and_cypher: Nodes: Paper {id, doi, pub_date, retracted_at, retraction_reasons, ref_total, refs_indexed, candidate, full, cited_n}, Author (hashed id), Venue {id, name, stratum}. Edges: CITES, PUBLISHED_IN, WROTE, COAUTHOR {n, first}, BIB_COUPLED {shared}. Indexes on Paper.id/doi/pub_date/retracted_at/candidate, Author.id, Venue.id. Cypher patterns: UNWIND $ids with WITH-barrier anchoring for planner control, 1-hop and 2-hop CITES traversal with NOT (p)-[:CITES]->(r) exclusion, as-of date filters, scratch labels (RetAuth, AsOf) with cleanup. Uses FalkorDB-native CALL algo.labelPropagation (not Neo4j GDS/APOC). Queries are plain files run as ro_query with params; no string-built user Cypher.
algorithms: 1-hop and 2-hop retracted-ancestor exposure over CITES (queries/audit/21_direct.cypher, 22_two_hop.cypher, called by Auditor.audit in src/bedrock/audit.py)
Bibliographic coupling edge derivation with citation-frequency cap and sliced execution (queries/11_derive_bib_coupled.cypher, scripts/derive_edges.py)
CALL algo.labelPropagation community detection over BIB_COUPLED for as-of populations (queries/features/38_community.cypher)
Venue-clustered bootstrap, AP and recall@k evaluation (scripts/evaluate.py: weighted_metrics, pct_rank)
Deterministic sorting of results so identical input yields identical output (Auditor.audit)
backend_interfaces: stdlib HTTP server (src/bedrock/server.py): GET /api/health; POST /api/audit, /api/apply, /api/agent; static UI; CSP and nosniff headers; 1 MB body cap
CLI scripts: serve.py, load_graph.py, derive_edges.py, compute_features.py, evaluate.py, snapshot.py (export/restore FalkorDB graph via DUMP/RESTORE)
frontend_interfaces: Static vanilla JS UI in src/bedrock/web (index.html, app.js, style.css, examples.json) and a marketing site in site/
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Bounded tool-calling loop (MAX_STEPS=6, explain_finding limit 3) over Groq with read-only tools audit_bibliography, explain_finding, find_dois. DOI allow-list prevents the model steering the audit; post-hoc verification flags ungrounded DOIs; human-in-the-loop approval gate for any action. No persistent memory.
tests_present: 9 test files in tests/ (agent, audit, evaluate, hashing, openalex, ratelimit, retraction_watch, server, venues) with about 90 test_ functions using a fixture module and fake graph/transport; no tests run against a live FalkorDB except scripts/smoke_test.py and verify_slim_graph.py. Not executed by auditor.
dependency_requirements: FalkorDB server with algo.labelPropagation (feature scripts only)
security_findings: scripts/derive_edges.py:121 - f-string builds MATCH ()-[e:{rel}]->() DELETE e, but rel iterates a hard-coded tuple (COAUTHOR, BIB_COUPLED); not injectable
scripts/load_graph.py:189-191 - f-string label/rel interpolation from internal constants; not user input
scripts/verify_slim_graph.py:37 - f-string WHERE clause assembled in a verification script; internal use only
scripts/snapshot.py:55-80 - Redis DUMP/RESTORE of a binary graph blob; restoring an untrusted .rdb.gz would be unsafe, the repo ships its own deploy/bedrock_slim.rdb.gz with a SHA-256 manifest
src/bedrock/server.py:100-110 - trusts last X-Forwarded-For entry only when BEDROCK_PUBLIC=1; reasonable; binds 127.0.0.1 by default
src/bedrock/retraction_watch.py:~85-100 - download follows redirects to a fixed gitlab.com URL; outbound calls limited to OpenAlex, Groq and gitlab
No hard-coded secrets found; keys come from .env/environment (.env.example has empty values); no eval/exec/pickle/subprocess found in src or scripts
duplicates_or_overlaps: Upstream-invalidates-downstream provenance (retracted paper -> citing works), overlapping research-integrity / citation-graph tools; conceptually overlaps dependency blast-radius traversal and lineage/provenance repos.
evidence_drift_relevance: HIGH - a retraction event with a date invalidates dependents 1 and 2 hops away, results are given as-of a date, proposals require explicit human approval before apply, and LLM answers are grounded against tool-returned DOIs.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Small, pure-Python, FalkorDB-native engine that turns an upstream invalidation event into a ranked list of downstream exposures (direct and 2-hop with explicit paths, coverage and caveats) with an approval-gated action layer; the Cypher in queries/audit/ is directly reusable, and the WITH-barrier planner trick is useful in Kairos.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB with a Paper/CITES graph (Retraction Watch + OpenAlex data for the original domain); no LLM key needed for the audit itself

strategy_rationale: The invalidation-propagation plus approval-gating pattern generalises beyond citations to any Kairos evidence graph (swap Paper/CITES for Evidence/DERIVED_FROM and retracted_at for superseded_at). The corpus-specific loaders and backtest should stay reference-only.
